findings.message:
Reentrancy in MONEY_BOX.Collect(uint256) (../sb/0xbe4041d55db380c5ae9d4a9b9703f1ed4e7e3888.sol#55-69):
	External calls:
	- msg.sender.call.value(_am)() (../sb/0xbe4041d55db380c5ae9d4a9b9703f1ed4e7e3888.sol#63)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- acc.balance -= _am (../sb/0xbe4041d55db380c5ae9d4a9b9703f1ed4e7e3888.sol#65)
	MONEY_BOX.Acc (../sb/0xbe4041d55db380c5ae9d4a9b9703f1ed4e7e3888.sol#17) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- MONEY_BOX.Acc (../sb/0xbe4041d55db380c5ae9d4a9b9703f1ed4e7e3888.sol#17)
	- MONEY_BOX.Collect(uint256) (../sb/0xbe4041d55db380c5ae9d4a9b9703f1ed4e7e3888.sol#55-69)
	- MONEY_BOX.Put(uint256) (../sb/0xbe4041d55db380c5ae9d4a9b9703f1ed4e7e3888.sol#45-53)
findings.name: reentrancy-eth
